title: Sparse Approximation via Polynomial Equations
summary: We consider the problem of finding sparse solutions of an underdetermined linear system $Ax=b$. In contrast to conventional approaches based on greedy algorithms or convex relaxation, we reformulate sparse approximation as a structured system of polynomial equations and connect with the literature on tensor methods. We develop an eigenvalue decomposition based method that formally guarantees recovery of all sparse solutions if there is more than one.
